title: Intake Air Heater Relay Short Circuit Error
detail_of_failure: Short circuit is sensed in the preheating relay drive circuit (primary circuit).
machine_effect: Intake air heater does not work in auto preheating mode (which causes degraded startability and emission of white smoke at low temperature).
related_information: • The temperature sensed by the charge air temperature sensor (boost temperature sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18500) • Troubleshooting of this failure code covers circuits from the engine controller to the primary (coil) side of preheating relay R18. • For troubleshooting of secondary circuit of heater relay and preheating relay R18, see “E-2” in E-mode. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to ON position. (Charge temperature: -4℃ and below)

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect relay R18, and connect a T-adapter to the male side.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CE02 and relay R18, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ground and CE02 (female) (40) or R18 (female) (1)

steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CE02 and relay R18, and connect a T-adapter to the female side of CE02. Do the check with the multimeter in the continuity mode.

measurements.point: Between CE02 (female) (40) and each pin other than pin (40)

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
